result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads. While a sidewalk is present on the residential side, parked vehicles near the crossing significantly obstruct sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: A large white van parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk blocks sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway, just past the crosswalk

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk on Park Side
hazards.description: The left side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk at the curb, forcing pedestrians to wait on grass or dirt.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the park edge

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

result.summary: This residential intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and continuous sidewalks in good condition. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing points create potential visibility and safety gaps for people walking.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the street approaching the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: While a traffic light is present, no dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install countdown pedestrian signals to provide clear guidance on when to cross and how much time remains.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and a basic sidewalk network. However, the lack of visible pedestrian signal heads and the absence of a refuge island on this two-lane road increase exposure for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signalization
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by a traffic light but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, which can lead to confusion and unsafe crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light pole on the left corner.

hazards.name: Exposure in Wide Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the full width of the roadway without a mid-block refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised refuge island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and a paved pedestrian path leading into a park area. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and markings are present, the environment lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signals and features a wide roadway that may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are clearly visible, which may lead to uncertainty for pedestrians crossing at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signal poles on the right side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The width of the roadway without a median refuge increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicular traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Adding dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers would provide clearer guidance and improve safety for those crossing.
